integrity: Finite experiments are direct arithmetic checks rather than a proof for arbitrary fields; the general proof is contained in RESULT.md. No independent mathematical audit or independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The normal form, geometry, rank and compatibility counts concern k[C4] in characteristic two and weight-zero operators; higher cyclic orders, other weights, full nonreduced scheme, and automorphism conjugacy remain outside scope. The rank-one specialization is known; independent review and exhaustive historical priority are not established.
title: Two-component geometry and compatible families of modular cyclic-four Rota–Baxter operators
